name: Cinder Crown - Full Feature Showcase
difficulty: medium; optional advanced stunt line; Unity tuning pending
intent: Showcase the library's roller, manual gap, explosive ring, high spring, barrel skybridge and long spring crossing.
signature: Full feature showcase / high lift / skybridge / long spring flight

stages.purpose: Gentle weight-transfer introduction on the demo's compact roller.
Conventional jump, compact deadzone and sloped catch.
Commit through the curved explosive ramp, invert, then continue over its revealed exit.
Reveal a higher terrace through vertical flight.
Optional forward-up barrel flourish with three obstacle coins and a clear return.
Wide final cinematic flight followed by stabilization.
Smooth return to the demo's original finish elevation.
